title: Admissible evolution satisfies four rules (Conservatio Continuum)

statements.text: A model of a physical or engineered system is admissible only if its evolution satisfies (1) a continuity relation, (2) closure of its conserved sectors, (3) invariance under the relevant symmetry action, and (4) consistency with a variational or storage principle. Conservation is a gate a model must pass first, not a property recovered after modeling.
